title: c4-findings — audit registry, superset of c4-health (problems not yet an issue)
description: The source of the briefing's 'does not add up' section. Empties only when a problem is fixed, never when it is hidden. Every row carries exactly one evidence ref — the column the briefing renders as mandatory. Agent-written rows carry auditedAt + evidenceHash stamped by Forma and expire like verdicts; gate-derived rows carry neither.

trace.description: Optional: 'issue' if this finding already has one, 'azione' if it is only an action item.

auditedAt.description: Manifest day on which Forma accepted the finding; stamped by the audit channel, never by the fill. Absent on findings the document gate re-derives every run — those are fresh by construction.

evidenceHash.description: Hash of the cited evidence at acceptance; a finding whose evidence moved is stale, not silently current.
